standalone.description: Run in standalone mode (recommended for dedicated servers); if false, use inetd/xinetd.

ipv6.description: Enable IPv6 listening (only effective in standalone mode).

bind_address.description: IP address or hostname the server will bind to (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces, or '127.0.0.1' for localhost only).

port.description: FTP control port to listen on.

max_clients.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connected clients.

max_clients_per_ip.description: Maximum connections allowed per client IP (0 = unlimited).

timeout.description: Idle timeout in seconds (session disconnects after this period of inactivity).

min_uid.description: Minimum system UID allowed to log in (prevents system accounts like root from authenticating).

require_valid_shell.description: Require users to have a valid shell listed in /etc/shells (enhances security by blocking nologin accounts).

tls.description: Enable TLS/SSL encryption for secure FTP connections (FTPS).

tls_cipher_suite.description: Colon-separated list of allowed TLS ciphersuites (used only if TLS enabled).

tls_certificate_path.description: Path to the combined certificate+private key PEM file for TLS.

force_tls.description: Force all clients to use TLS (disables plaintext FTP).

passive_port_min.description: Low end of the passive data port range (must match firewall rules).

passive_port_max.description: High end of the passive data port range (must match firewall rules).

public_host.description: Public IP or hostname to advertise for passive connections (required if behind NAT/firewall).

anonymous_enabled.description: Allow anonymous FTP login (disabled by default for security).

unix_authentication.description: Enable authentication via system users (via PAM). Disable to use pure-authd or LDAP.

value.description: Value to write to the conf file.

ldap_configs.description: List of LDAP-related configuration overrides (key = filename, value = content). Only used if LDAP auth is enabled.

custom_settings.description: Key-value pairs for any additional Pure-FTPd configuration files (e.g., { 'AltLog': 'clf:/var/log/pure-ftpd/transfer.log' }).
